title: Verifiable AI-Builder Profile
description: The ONLY payload submitted to public-dj. HARD ALLOWLIST: additionalProperties is false at every level, every string is length/enum/pattern bounded, opaque ids are hex-only, and no field is named for a path, filename, author email/name, raw code, or secret. STRUCTURAL guarantees are: (i) closed objects (no extra fields), (ii) type/length/enum/pattern bounds, (iii) hex-only opaque ids that cannot encode a path/identifier/email/repo-or-org name. PII exclusion WITHIN allowed free-text fields (e.g. rationale, excerpt, summary) is NOT provided by length bounds; it is enforced by the two redaction layers + public-dj's independent re-scrub-and-REJECT. It is the 1:1 mirror of docs/data-handling.md, enforced fail-closed by BOTH the client Validator and public-dj ingestion. Raw transcripts and source code are NEVER part of this payload.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the payload was built against. Frozen per release.

rubric_version.description: Version of skill/rubric.md used to score. Decoupled from the schema pin as of 1.1.0: the allowed pairings (the 1.1.0 and 1.2.0 schemas each accept rubric 1.0.0 or 1.1.0) are enforced by a server-side compatibility map in public-dj schema_validation, not by this const.

handle.description: Lowercased GitHub username. The ONLY identity field. Comes from the verified submission token's claims, never from transcript text. public-dj overwrites/validates this against the token on ingestion.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 timestamp when the profile was synthesized.

agent.description: Which coding agent performed the local analysis. No version path or install location.

tool_version.description: Reported agent CLI version string only (e.g. '1.2.3'). Pattern excludes '/', whitespace, and '@' so no path/host can hide here.

parallelism.description: Whether the run used true subagent parallelism or a sequential-shard fallback.

analysis_manifest.description: Aggregate run statistics. Counts and windows only; nothing identifying.

project_scope.description: Confirmation the analysis was scoped to a single chosen project. NEVER a name, path, or remote URL — only the assertion and a count of repos considered (must be 1).

dimensions.description: The eight competency dimensions. A dimension key is OMITTED entirely when there is no direct evidence (omission != low score). Every present dimension MUST carry >=2 cited, redacted evidence excerpts. These scores are RECOMPUTED server-side by public-dj from the verified per-episode scores (rubric.md §4); client-submitted values are advisory display hints only and are overwritten on ingestion.

archetype.description: Short builder archetype label (e.g. 'Systems Architect', 'Rapid Prototyper'). Generated narrative; re-scrubbed.

overall_summary.description: Scrubbed narrative summary. LLM-generated text is re-run through both redaction layers before it lands here.

episode_scores.description: Per-episode scoring records; the unit of analysis is the EPISODE, not the session. An episode can only be listed if the public-dj scoring proxy scored it and returned a nonce (nonce is required), so unscored episodes are simply ABSENT rather than submitted unverified. On ingestion public-dj recomputes each nonce; an episode whose nonce FAILS verification is stored held (verified=false). public-dj also requires the submitted set to cover EVERY request_id the proxy issued for this submission token (blocks dropping low-scoring episodes), and RECOMPUTES all aggregate scores (dimensions.*, overall_*) from the verified per-episode scores per rubric.md §4.

session_metadata.description: Per-session aggregate metadata. session_ref is an opaque, locally-salted hash, never the real session id or any path.

git_metrics.description: Aggregate git statistics derived host-side. NO per-file paths, NO filenames, NO author name, NO author email. File involvement expressed only as counts and extension histograms.

vibe_loc_sources.description: Numeric-only source breakdown for Vibe LOC. committed is author-filtered git history; tracked_working_tree is git diff additions; untracked is safe code-file line counts after local denylist filtering.

vibe_loc_by_period.description: Lines-added breakdown for leaderboard/global comparison. UTC calendar buckets only; no paths, filenames, commit hashes, author data, or repo identifiers.

vibe_loc_by_local_period.description: Lines-added breakdown for profile display using the builder machine's local calendar buckets. No paths, filenames, commit hashes, author data, or repo identifiers.

metrics_timezone.description: Coarse local offset used for local-period profile display, e.g. UTC-07:00. Never an IANA location.

extension_histogram.description: Map of file EXTENSION (no dot, no path) -> change count. Extensions only; e.g. {"ts": 40, "py": 12}. Keys validated against a safe pattern.

night_owl_share.description: Share of author-filtered commits landing 22:00-02:00 in the author's LOCAL clock (derived from %cI offsets; no timezone name is ever shipped).

biggest_push.description: The single biggest calendar day by lines added. WEEKDAY ONLY — the exact date would be cross-referenceable against public repo activity given the handle.

last_30_days.description: Rolling trailing-30-day window (author-filtered), unlike the calendar buckets in vibe_loc_by_period.

vibe_metrics.description: Uncapped aggregate-only local metrics for public profile display. Counts, hours, provider-token totals, source status, and coverage only; no raw transcripts, paths, filenames, ids, commit hashes, authors, or code.

vibe_agent_hours_by_period.description: Summed agent-hours by UTC calendar bucket. Derived from timestamped local activity intervals only.

active_calendar_hours_by_period.description: De-duplicated active calendar hours by UTC calendar bucket.

provider_tokens_by_period.description: Provider-reported token totals by UTC calendar bucket. Estimates are excluded.

total_vibe_loc.description: Total public Vibe LOC: committed git insertions plus tracked working-tree additions plus untracked code-file lines after local denylist filtering.

vibe_loc_sources.description: Numeric-only source breakdown for total_vibe_loc. No file paths, filenames, hashes, repo names, authors, or code.

vibe_loc_by_period.description: Lines-added breakdown for leaderboard/global comparison. UTC calendar buckets only; no paths, filenames, commit hashes, author data, or repo identifiers.

vibe_loc_by_local_period.description: Lines-added breakdown for profile display using the builder machine's local calendar buckets. No paths, filenames, commit hashes, author data, or repo identifiers.

metrics_timezone.description: Coarse local offset used for local-period profile display, e.g. UTC-07:00. Never an IANA location.

last_stats_refresh_at.description: UTC timestamp for the latest deterministic metrics-only refresh.

next_stats_refresh_at.description: UTC timestamp when deterministic metrics should refresh next.

last_ai_analysis_at.description: UTC timestamp for the latest full AI-scored profile analysis.

next_ai_analysis_at.description: UTC timestamp when full AI analysis should run next.

analysis_cadence.description: Cadence label for full AI-scored profile analysis.

metrics_refresh_cadence.description: Cadence label for deterministic metrics refresh.

model_usage.description: Per model-family usage split. Families come from a fixed client-side allowlist map (fail-closed); raw ids that do not normalize are dropped, so free text can never ride along.

concurrency.description: Sweep-line maxima over active intervals. peak_at is hour-truncated. Repo identities never appear — only counts.

prompt_stats.description: Numeric-only prompt analytics over HUMAN prompts (tool results, sidechains, SDK prompts, command wrappers, and queued duplicates excluded). No prompt text ships in this block.

opener_split.description: How sessions open, as shares of first human prompts.

longest_agent_run.description: Longest autonomous run between human inputs. The label is the episode-type enum only — no free text.

last_30_days.description: Rolling trailing-30-day window, unlike the calendar period buckets.

recent_commits.description: Scrubbed commit subjects with timestamps ONLY. No author name, no author email, and NO commit hash (a real short hash is cross-referenceable against the public repo and would deanonymize the user/repo/author given the handle). Subjects pass both redaction layers.

decisions.description: Notable steering/architecture decisions, fully redacted. proposal/response are paraphrased and scrubbed — never raw transcript or code.

code_quality.description: Aggregate code-quality signals inferred from behavior. Booleans and counts only; never code.

work_streams.description: Multi-session work streams grouped by salted branch ref + overlapping time windows, with commits attached by time+branch match. Counts and durations only; no titles, branch names, or paths.

craft_stats.description: Deterministic engineering-craft aggregates. All shares are 0-1; the command classifier behind the *_rate fields is versioned in client_telemetry.classifier_version.

context_craft_edit_count.description: Edits to agent-context files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, SKILL.md, rules dirs) matched against a fixed basename allowlist; paths never ship.

cross_tool_spawn_share.description: Share of Codex sessions whose originator is another agent tool rather than the human's CLI.

first_contact.description: Earliest corroborated agent activity. Requires >=2 sources active within 30 days of the claimed origin (anti-backdating).

operating_level.description: Evidence-anchored operating band (rubric 1.1). NEVER a job title. Stored on ingest but served by public-dj only for maturity-established profiles with sufficient episode counts.

specialty_signals.description: Topic-tagged sub-scores: architecture-dimension evidence filtered to a fixed topic taxonomy. Omit a topic with no evidence.

client_telemetry.description: Non-identifying client run telemetry. OS FAMILY only (darwin/linux/win), never hostname/username/path.

repo_architecture.description: OPTIONAL, presence-gated repo-architecture scorecards scored under skill/repo_rubric.md. This is the structural ARTIFACT signal, separate from the transcript SESSION signal; the two are never auto-merged. Scorecards come from explicit, per-repo user-consented LOCAL scans (the analyze_repo_architecture tool) and are SELF-REPORTED: server-side re-verification is a later slice. This block does NOT relax analysis_manifest.project_scope — repos_considered == 1 still attests that TRANSCRIPT analysis covered exactly one project; scanned repos are a separate, explicitly selected set. Contents are numbers, booleans, pinned enums, and salted hex opaque refs only, plus at most two paraphrased, double-redacted notes per repo. Repos are identified by primary_language + size_band only — never by name, path, or remote, and nothing from the scanner's local_only block may ever appear here.

repo_rubric_version.description: Version of skill/repo_rubric.md (and the paired scanner) that produced these scorecards. A separate version line from schema_version/rubric_version; accepted pairings are enforced by public-dj's server-side compatibility map, not by this enum alone.

combined_score.description: ADVISORY blended headline per skill/repo_rubric.md §6: round(0.65 * overall_score + 0.35 * repo_architecture.portfolio.mean_overall), Math.round half-up semantics (W_SESSION/W_ARTIFACT are pinned in mcp/src/repo-architecture.ts). A client display hint only — a later public-dj slice recomputes it server-side. May only be present together with repo_architecture and combined_grade (dependentRequired).

combined_grade.description: Grade band for combined_score, same table as overall_grade. Advisory; recomputed server-side in a later slice. May only be present together with repo_architecture and combined_score (dependentRequired).

shipped_with_ai.description: Outcome layer: what the builder shipped with AI. mode 'approved_items' carries explicitly CLI-approved public items; 'aggregate_only' carries deterministic counts only. Detection runs locally; raw candidates (paths, repo names, hashes) never leave the machine. summary and mode/items consistency are server-recomputed/enforced when items are present.

redaction_report.description: Client self-attestation that both redaction layers ran fail-closed. ADVISORY/telemetry only: public-dj independently re-runs BOTH redactors over EVERY text field regardless of these counts and REJECTS the whole submission on any hit. Both layer booleans must be true (a single layer is not acceptable).

profileAnalysisOverhead.description: Aggregate-only audit of Vibexp's own profile-analysis (measurement) sessions, which are EXCLUDED from all normal builder metrics, model usage, episode candidates, and leaderboard fields. Counts and totals only; never used for ranking.

shippedSummary.description: Deterministic aggregate counts over locally-detected shipped candidates. Server-recomputed from approved items when mode is approved_items; client values are advisory.

shippedItem.description: One user-APPROVED public shipped item. title and public_url are the only allowlisted free-name fields in the profile: they may carry product/repo names after explicit CLI approval, are length-bounded and secret-scanned, and public_url is https-only — but both skip the path/identifier redaction layer by design. Raw detection candidates never ship.

shipped_on.description: Shipped period as YYYY-MM (month precision; exact dates withheld by design).

rationale.description: Scrubbed rationale for the score. Re-run through both redaction layers.

evidence.description: 2-3 cited, redacted excerpts proving the score. No evidence => the dimension must be omitted, not scored.

excerpt.description: A short, paraphrased-and-scrubbed quote illustrating the behavior. NEVER raw code, paths, identifiers, or secrets. Passes both redaction layers.

why.description: One line: why this excerpt supports the score.

scores.description: Per-dimension mini-scores for this episode. Only dimensions with evidence in this episode appear.

scoringNonce.description:
Proxy-issued, tamper-evident integrity token; the public-dj scoring proxy returns one per episode it scores. FROZEN CANONICAL PREIMAGE: signature = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(server_key, request_id + '
' + handle + '
' + digest + '
' + canonical_scores)), where digest = base64url(SHA-256(JCS({episode_id, type, scores}))), JCS = RFC 8785 canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace), canonical_scores = JCS of the scores object, and handle is the verified submission-token handle (binds the nonce to the submitter, preventing cross-account replay). On ingestion public-dj RECOMPUTES digest+signature from the SUBMITTED episode + its own server_key + the token handle, treats the proxy-log scores as authoritative (overwriting submitted episode scores), and HOLDS the episode (verified=false) on any of: signature mismatch, digest != submitted episode, handle mismatch, expired/unknown request_id, or request_id not in the proxy log for this token.

signature.description: Base64url HMAC-SHA256 over the frozen preimage (see scoringNonce.description).

digest.description: Base64url-unpadded SHA-256 (exactly 43 chars) of JCS({episode_id, type, scores}). public-dj recomputes from the submitted episode and compares.

first_prompt.description: Scrubbed first user prompt, bounded. Passes both redaction layers.

proposal.description: Paraphrased, scrubbed description of what was proposed. Never raw transcript/code.

response.description: Paraphrased, scrubbed description of the human's decision/response.

initiative.description: Who raised the concern/direction first (rubric 1.1 initiative attribution).

outcome_evidence.description: Deterministic outcome linkage (rubric 1.1): what actually happened after the decision.

topics.description: Fixed topic taxonomy tags feeding specialty_signals.

episodeId.description: Stable opaque episode id: a locally-generated hex digest (e.g. truncated salted SHA-256). Hex-only (0-9a-f) so it cannot encode a path, code identifier, email, or repo/org name.

opaqueRef.description: Opaque, locally-salted reference: a hex digest (e.g. truncated HMAC of the real id). Hex-only so it cannot encode a session id, path, filename, identifier, or repo/org name.

hourHistogram24.description: 24 LOCAL-clock hour bins (00..23). Derived from per-record offsets; no timezone identifier ever ships.

repoDimension.description: One submitted repo dimension. NA-strict: status 'na' means NO evidence either way and the score key is OMITTED entirely (never null); evidence of weak practice is a LOW SCORE with status 'scored', never 'na'; a dimension key is never dropped. The scanner-side 'llm_required' status never ships — the host agent LLM-scores architecture locally (repo_rubric.md §2.8) before assembly, or sets 'na'.

repoMaintainabilityDimension.description: maintainability additionally carries deterministic_score: the scanner's reproducible anchor (repo_rubric.md §2.9). score may differ from deterministic_score only via the host agent's bounded, marker-grounded local refinement; deterministic_score is never adjusted. Both score keys are OMITTED when status is 'na'.

repoMarkers.description: Deterministic scanner markers, copied VERBATIM from analyze_repo_architecture (repo_rubric.md §2): numbers and booleans ONLY, the full pinned key set per dimension, always fully present even when the dimension is 'na'. The secret scan contributes COUNTS only — never values or locations. The scan's local_only block (repo-relative paths) must NEVER appear in a profile.

repoScorecard.description: One explicitly user-selected, locally scanned repository. repo_ref is minted with the SAME salted opaque-ref mechanism as every other ref: truncated (24 hex chars) SHA-256 of salt ‖ 'repo' ‖ absolute-repo-path, NUL-joined, where salt = SHA-256('viber-local-v1' ‖ selected-project-path ‖ home-dir) — never a repo name, path, or remote. quality/coverage/overall/grade follow the pinned repo_rubric.md §4 math (quality = mean score over status=='scored' dims, round2 for transport; coverage = scored_count/10 exact; overall = round(unrounded_quality * (0.5 + 0.5 * coverage)) clamped 0-100; grade per the overall_grade band table). All are advisory display hints recomputable from the integer dimension scores. Self-reported; server re-verification is a later slice.

dimensions.description: All 10 fixed repo_rubric dimension keys are REQUIRED, in every scorecard — a key is never dropped (NA-strict: status 'na' instead).

notes.description: At most two OPTIONAL paraphrased narrative notes — the ONLY free text in the repo block: the host agent's architecture judgment rationale and maintainability refinement rationale. Both pass BOTH redaction layers (and public-dj's independent re-scrub): no paths, file/repo/org names, identifiers, secrets, or code.

repoPortfolio.description: Portfolio rollup over scorecards (repo_rubric.md §5) — advisory display hints fully recomputable from the scorecards. The richer §5 fields (per-dimension best, language share mix) are intentionally NOT duplicated here: they are display-derivable from the submitted scorecards.

by_dimension.description: All 10 repo_rubric dimension keys are REQUIRED (NA-strict at the portfolio level too: a key is never dropped).

primary_languages.description: Deduplicated primary_language values across scorecards, in first-seen scorecard order.

repoMeanOrNa.description: Rounded mean score over the scorecards where this dimension has status 'scored', or the literal string 'na' when no scanned repo scored it. Self-bounding type union: numbers are clamped 0-100 (minimum/maximum apply to the number branch), and the only legal string is 'na' (pattern applies to the string branch).
